Paras Healthcare Plans Rs 1450 Crore IPO, Debt Reduction, Expansion

Paras Healthcare is planning an Initial Public Offering (IPO) to raise Rs 1450 crore. The company intends to use approximately ₹375 crore from the IPO proceeds to reduce its debt. Additionally, Paras Healthcare plans to use a portion of the funds for an expansion project, which includes establishing 800 new beds. The IPO is scheduled to open on October 21.
